# U72: One way out of a form: each focus-mode page has one closing control with words (“Close and keep the draft” or “Close without saving”); closing a review’s set-up with something typed asks first, and Keep editing keeps it; Import’s check and its changes have one too, which goes back to Import

- **Belongs to:** the Spreadsheets module ([its section](../README.md#journeys-and-checks)), and also the Metric library module ([its page](../../metrics/journeys/U72.md)) and the Reviews module ([its page](../../reviews/journeys/U72.md)); it runs with each of them on
- **Requirements:** `NAV-FORMS`
- **Budget:** at most 3 steps on each width
- **Ease test:** every point but `logged` ([the ease test](../../../core/journeys.md#the-ease-test))
- **Runs on:** a phone (390 × 844) and a desktop (1440 × 900), the same lines on each unless one says otherwise
- **Starts:** As Rhea, at `{addr}` in the demo.
- **Source:** `evals/journeys.cjs`, the entry for U72

## Steps and checks

- Open a fresh browser as Rhea (`rhea`).
- Repeated, as the code loops, 9 rows:
  - _Row:_ “/check-in/ci-docker”, “Close”
  - _Row:_ “/reviews/new”, “Close without saving”
  - _Row:_ “/reviews/weekly/edit”, “Close without saving”
  - _Row:_ “/workspace/new”, “Close”
  - _Row:_ “/goals/new”, “Close”
  - _Row:_ “/goals/ci-docker/edit”, “Close”
  - _Row:_ “/quick-check-in”, “Close”
  - _Row:_ “/data/import”, “Close without saving”
  - _Row:_ “/metrics/new”, “Close”
  - Go to `{addr}` in the demo.
  - **Check:** The top of the check-in shows.
  - _Note:_ Goal edit's second exit, back to the goal, is gone (navigation spec 2.5).
  - _Note:_ A form draws no back link either, a module's focus page included (build review of #282).
- **Check:** (`entry`) met when `!wrong.length`, where `const wrong = []`. Else it says: {wrong.join('; ')}.
- **Check:** (`one-action`) scored as met here.
- **Check:** Checkpoint “closers”: the screen is scored for `one-action` and `a11y`.
- _Note:_ Something typed in a review's set-up: closing asks first; Keep editing keeps it; Close without saving leaves.
- Go to `/reviews/new` in the demo.
- **Step.** Type “Thursday walk-through” into the “Name” field.
- **Step.** Press the “Close without saving” button.
- **Check:** The “Close without saving?” dialog shows.
- **Check:** (`errors`) met when `await ask.isVisible() && /What you typed here will be lost\./.test(await ask.innerText())`, where `const ask = p.getByRole('dialog', { name: 'Close without saving?' })`. Else it says: closing with something typed does not ask first.
- Press the “Keep editing” button in the “Close without saving?” dialog.
- **Check:** (`progress`) met when `(await p.getByLabel('Name', { exact: true }).inputValue()) === 'Thursday walk-through'`. Else it says: Keep editing lost what was typed.
- **Step.** Press the “Close without saving” button.
- Press the “Close without saving” button in the “Close without saving?” dialog.
- **Check:** The address becomes “/reviews”.
- **Check:** (`finish`) the address matches “/reviews” (else: Close without saving went to {p.url()}).
- _Note:_ Import's check and its changes are forms once a file is read (review of #328): one closer each, which forgets the file and goes back to Import. Set up with plain calls: the steps counted are the review's.
- Go to `/data/import` in the demo.
- Press the “or paste rows from a spreadsheet” button.
- Type “Goal	Owner	Team	Unit	Start	Target
A way out of the check	Rhea Kapoor	CI/CD	%	20	90
” into the “Paste rows from a spreadsheet” field.
- Press the “Check these rows” button.
- Repeated, as the code loops:
  - **Check:** The address becomes “{page.replace(///g, '\/')}”.
  - **Check:** The top of the check-in shows.
- **Check:** The address becomes “/data/import”.
- **Check:** (`progress`) met when `!shut.length`, where `const shut = []`. Else it says: {shut.join('; ')}.
- **Check:** (`attention`) scored as met here.
- **Check:** (`parity`) scored as met here.
- Close this browser.
